ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
spiritName = "Tempers of the Ever-Changing Skies"

local pos
-- Indicator states: 1=Ire, 2=Joy, 3=Calm, 4=Sorrow
local EMOTIONS = {"Ire", "Joy", "Calm", "Sorrow"}
local SEASON_ELEMENTS = {
    Ire = "Season Elements: Sun and Fire",
    Joy = "Season Elements: Sun and Air",
    Calm = "Season Elements: Water and Air",
    Sorrow = "Season Elements: Water and Fire"
}

-- Mapping of seasons to their element pairs
local SEASON_TO_ELEMENTS = {
    Ire = {"Sun", "Fire"},
    Joy = {"Sun", "Air"},
    Calm = {"Water", "Air"},
    Sorrow = {"Water", "Fire"}
}

-- Element JSON data for spawning
local ELEMENT_JSON = {
    Sun = [[{"GUID":"fe04ab","Name":"Custom_Model","Transform":{"posX":0,"posY":1,"posZ":0,"rotX":0,"rotY":180,"rotZ":0,"scaleX":0.5,"scaleY":0.5,"scaleZ":0.5},"Nickname":"Sun Element","Description":"Use these for when a powers/events/growths which gift elements, or when you reveal an element on your presence tracks","GMNotes":"","AltLookAngle":{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0},"ColorDiffuse":{"r":1.0,"g":0.8513,"b":0.0},"Tags":["Destroy","Sun"],"LayoutGroupSortIndex":0,"Value":0,"Locked":false,"Grid":false,"Snap":true,"IgnoreFoW":false,"MeasureMovement":false,"DragSelectable":true,"Autoraise":true,"Sticky":false,"Tooltip":true,"GridProjection":false,"HideWhenFaceDown":false,"Hands":false,"CustomMesh":{"MeshURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530847955752/9AFCE5ED45E9AD8F572BA91EE17D27703EE5E3D1/","DiffuseURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530848003345/A0139159D20B8012E78D0AB7E6861C403CC7C8E2/","NormalURL":"","ColliderURL":"","Convex":true,"MaterialIndex":1,"TypeIndex":0,"CastShadows":true},"LuaScript":"elements=\"10000000\"","LuaScriptState":"","XmlUI":""}]],
    Fire = [[{"GUID":"e6db03","Name":"Custom_Model","Transform":{"posX":0,"posY":1,"posZ":0,"rotX":0,"rotY":180,"rotZ":0,"scaleX":0.5,"scaleY":0.5,"scaleZ":0.5},"Nickname":"Fire Element","Description":"Use these for when a powers/events/growths which gift elements, or when you reveal an element on your presence tracks","GMNotes":"","AltLookAngle":{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0},"ColorDiffuse":{"r":1.0,"g":0.375499725,"b":0.0},"Tags":["Destroy","Fire"],"LayoutGroupSortIndex":0,"Value":0,"Locked":false,"Grid":false,"Snap":true,"IgnoreFoW":false,"MeasureMovement":false,"DragSelectable":true,"Autoraise":true,"Sticky":false,"Tooltip":true,"GridProjection":false,"HideWhenFaceDown":false,"Hands":false,"CustomMesh":{"MeshURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530847955752/9AFCE5ED45E9AD8F572BA91EE17D27703EE5E3D1/","DiffuseURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530848022583/E829535EC9D3A4B5E1A962555788738AFDA20FAB/","NormalURL":"","ColliderURL":"","Convex":true,"MaterialIndex":1,"TypeIndex":0,"CastShadows":true},"LuaScript":"elements=\"00100000\"","LuaScriptState":"","XmlUI":""}]],
    Air = [[{"GUID":"c73997","Name":"Custom_Model","Transform":{"posX":0,"posY":1,"posZ":0,"rotX":0,"rotY":180,"rotZ":0,"scaleX":0.5,"scaleY":0.5,"scaleZ":0.5},"Nickname":"Air Element","Description":"Use these for when a powers/events/growths which gift elements, or when you reveal an element on your presence tracks","GMNotes":"","AltLookAngle":{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0},"ColorDiffuse":{"r":0.6534,"g":0.332899749,"b":0.9321},"Tags":["Air","Destroy"],"LayoutGroupSortIndex":0,"Value":0,"Locked":false,"Grid":false,"Snap":true,"IgnoreFoW":false,"MeasureMovement":false,"DragSelectable":true,"Autoraise":true,"Sticky":false,"Tooltip":true,"GridProjection":false,"HideWhenFaceDown":false,"Hands":false,"CustomMesh":{"MeshURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530847955752/9AFCE5ED45E9AD8F572BA91EE17D27703EE5E3D1/","DiffuseURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530847996722/ED7C910E05283842C749159B9EA5B948A6EE4E82/","NormalURL":"","ColliderURL":"","Convex":true,"MaterialIndex":1,"TypeIndex":0,"CastShadows":true},"LuaScript":"elements=\"00010000\"","LuaScriptState":"","XmlUI":""}]],
    Water = [[{"GUID":"d440a5","Name":"Custom_Model","Transform":{"posX":0,"posY":1,"posZ":0,"rotX":0,"rotY":180,"rotZ":0,"scaleX":0.5,"scaleY":0.5,"scaleZ":0.5},"Nickname":"Water Element","Description":"Use these for when a powers/events/growths which gift elements, or when you reveal an element on your presence tracks","GMNotes":"","AltLookAngle":{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0},"ColorDiffuse":{"r":0.198299766,"g":0.423699766,"b":0.8391},"Tags":["Destroy","Water"],"LayoutGroupSortIndex":0,"Value":0,"Locked":false,"Grid":false,"Snap":true,"IgnoreFoW":false,"MeasureMovement":false,"DragSelectable":true,"Autoraise":true,"Sticky":false,"Tooltip":true,"GridProjection":false,"HideWhenFaceDown":false,"Hands":false,"CustomMesh":{"MeshURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932530847955752/9AFCE5ED45E9AD8F572BA91EE17D27703EE5E3D1/","DiffuseURL":"https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1747932596329702298/A506113CA23809C5D314B2010E9129C7084DE53D/","NormalURL":"","ColliderURL":"","Convex":true,"MaterialIndex":1,"TypeIndex":0,"CastShadows":true},"LuaScript":"elements=\"00001000\"","LuaScriptState":"","XmlUI":""}]]
}
local seasonIndicator = nil
local activated = false
local playerColor = nil
local panelGUID = nil  -- Store panel GUID for save/load
local isChangingSeason = false  -- Debounce flag to prevent rapid clicks
local initialized = false  -- Track if setup has been run
local autoAdvanceOnTimePasses = true  -- Toggle for automatic season advance during Time Passes

-----------------------------------------
-- Forward declarations for local functions
-----------------------------------------
local getIndicatorEmotion
local cycleSeasonIndicator
local refreshIndicatorReference
local findInnateWithTagInHand
local findInnateWithTagInHandObjects
local findInnateInHits
local getCardEmotion

-----------------------------------------
-- Local function implementations
-----------------------------------------

-- Re-find the indicator object (needed because setState destroys and recreates the object)
refreshIndicatorReference = function()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.getName():find("Season Indicator") then
            seasonIndicator = obj
            return true
        end
    end
    seasonIndicator = nil
    return false
end

getIndicatorEmotion = function()
    refreshIndicatorReference()
    if not seasonIndicator then return "Ire" end
    local stateId = seasonIndicator.getStateId()
    if stateId == -1 then stateId = 1 end
    -- States: 1=Ire, 2=Joy, 3=Calm, 4=Sorrow
    return EMOTIONS[stateId] or "Ire"
end

-- Get the emotion tag from a card
getCardEmotion = function(card)
    if not card then return nil end
    for _, emotion in ipairs(EMOTIONS) do
        if card.hasTag(emotion) then
            return emotion
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Cycle the indicator forward or backward, returning the new emotion tag
cycleSeasonIndicator = function(reverse)
    -- Always re-find the indicator in case it was manually changed
    -- (manual state changes destroy the old object and create a new one)
    refreshIndicatorReference()
    if not seasonIndicator then return "Ire" end

    local currentState = seasonIndicator.getStateId()
    if currentState == -1 then currentState = 1 end

    -- Remember lock state before setState (which destroys and recreates the object)
    local wasLocked = seasonIndicator.getLock()

    local numStates = #EMOTIONS
    local nextState
    if reverse then
        -- Go backwards: 1->4, 2->1, 3->2, 4->3
        nextState = ((currentState - 2) % numStates) + 1
    else
        -- Go forwards: 1->2, 2->3, 3->4, 4->1
        nextState = (currentState % numStates) + 1
    end

    -- setState returns new object reference; update our reference
    if nextState ~= currentState then
        seasonIndicator = seasonIndicator.setState(nextState)
        -- Restore lock state on the new object
        if wasLocked then
            seasonIndicator.setLock(true)
        end
    end

    return EMOTIONS[nextState] or "Ire"
end

findInnateWithTagInHand = function(color, handIndex, tagName)
    local hand = Player[color].getHandObjects(handIndex)
    for _, obj in ipairs(hand) do
        if obj.hasTag("Innate") and obj.hasTag(tagName) then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Version that searches a provided hand objects table
findInnateWithTagInHandObjects = function(handObjects, tagName)
    for _, obj in ipairs(handObjects) do
        if obj.hasTag("Innate") and obj.hasTag(tagName) then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Helper to find Innate card from physics cast hits
findInnateInHits = function(hits)
    for _, hit in pairs(hits) do
        local card = hit.hit_object
        if card and card.hasTag("Innate") then
            return card
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Save/Load handlers for persistence
-----------------------------------------

function onSave()
    local state = {
        pos = pos,
        playerColor = playerColor,
        panelGUID = panelGUID,
        activated = activated,
        initialized = initialized,
        autoAdvanceOnTimePasses = autoAdvanceOnTimePasses
    }
    return JSON.encode(state)
end

function onLoad(savedState)
    if savedState and savedState ~= "" then
        local state = JSON.decode(savedState)
        if state then
            playerColor = state.playerColor
            activated = state.activated or false
            initialized = state.initialized or false
            panelGUID = state.panelGUID
            -- Restore toggle state (default to true if not present for backwards compatibility)
            if state.autoAdvanceOnTimePasses ~= nil then
                autoAdvanceOnTimePasses = state.autoAdvanceOnTimePasses
            else
                autoAdvanceOnTimePasses = true
            end
            -- Restore pos as a Vector
            if state.pos then
                pos = Vector(state.pos[1] or state.pos.x or 0, 
                             state.pos[2] or state.pos.y or 0, 
                             state.pos[3] or state.pos.z or 0)
            end
        end
    end

    -- If we were initialized before save, restore the button
    if initialized and panelGUID then
        Wait.frames(function()
            local panel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
            if panel then
                createPanelButtons(panel)
            end
            updateIndicatorDisplay()
            -- Re-hide if it was activated
            if activated then
                self.setInvisibleTo(Player.getColors())
            end
        end, 5)
    end
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Setup function
-----------------------------------------

function doSetup(params)
    local color = params.color
    playerColor = color
    local panel = params.spiritPanel
    panelGUID = panel.getGUID()  -- Store for save/load
    self.locked = true
    local position = panel.getPosition() + Vector(-8.2,-0.22,3.4)
    pos = position
    self.setPosition(position)

    -- Find the Season Indicator object by searching for it on the table
    refreshIndicatorReference()

    -- Spawn the new hand (hand index 3)
    local handPosition = Player[color].getHandTransform(2).position
    handPosition.z = handPosition.z - 5.5
    Global.call("SpawnHand", {color = color, position = handPosition})

    -- Determine which emotion the indicator is currently showing
    local startingEmotion = getIndicatorEmotion()

    -- Wait for hand 3 to be created, then process Innate cards
    -- Use longer delay (30 frames ~0.5s) to ensure hand is ready
    Wait.frames(function()
        -- Re-fetch hand objects inside callback to get current state
        local hand = Player[color].getHandObjects(1)
        if hand and #hand > 0 then
            -- Find the card that matches the indicator's starting emotion
            local startingCard = findInnateWithTagInHandObjects(hand, startingEmotion)

            for _,card in pairs(hand) do
                if card.hasTag("Innate") then
                    if card == startingCard then
                        -- Place matching card directly on the panel
                        local targetPos = pos + Vector(8.5, 0.5, -9.75)
                        card.setPosition(targetPos, false)
                    else
                        -- Send other innates to hand 3
                        card.deal(1, color, 3)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end, 30)

    createPanelButtons(panel)
    updateIndicatorDisplay()
    initialized = true

    return true
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Panel button creation
-----------------------------------------

function createPanelButtons(panel)
    -- Remove existing buttons first to avoid duplicates on reload
    panel.clearButtons()
    
    panel.createButton({
        click_function = "changeSeason",
        function_owner = self,
        label = "Change Season",
        position = {-0.93,0.5,0},
        scale = {x=0.08, y=0.08, z=0.08},
        width = 5000,
        height = 750,
        font_size = 750,
        color = {1,1,1},
        font_color = {0,0,0},
        tooltip = "Left-click: Next Season | Right-click: Previous Season",
    })
    
    -- Checkbox toggle for Time Passes auto-advance
    local checkboxLabel = autoAdvanceOnTimePasses and "[X] Time Passes Sync" or "[  ] Time Passes Sync"
    panel.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleTimePasses",
        function_owner = self,
        label = checkboxLabel,
        position = {-0.93,0.5,0.15},
        scale = {x=0.08, y=0.08, z=0.08},
        width = 5000,
        height = 600,
        font_size = 550,
        color = {0.9,0.9,0.9},
        font_color = {0,0,0},
        tooltip = "Toggle automatic season advance during Time Passes",
    })
    
    -- Also update the Season Indicator display
    updateIndicatorDisplay()
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Season Indicator display
-----------------------------------------

function updateIndicatorDisplay()
    refreshIndicatorReference()
    if not seasonIndicator then return end
    
    -- Clear existing buttons on the indicator
    seasonIndicator.clearButtons()
    
    -- Get current emotion and display text
    local currentEmotion = getIndicatorEmotion()
    local elementsText = SEASON_ELEMENTS[currentEmotion] or "Season Elements: Unknown"
    
    -- Create text display on the Season Indicator (positioned below the tile)
    seasonIndicator.createButton({
        click_function = "spawnSeasonElements",
        function_owner = self,
        label = elementsText,
        position = {0, 0.2, 1.2},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        scale = {x=0.5, y=0.5, z=0.5},
        width = 2200,
        height = 350,
        font_size = 150,
        color = {0.85,0.85,0.85},
        font_color = {0.1,0.1,0.1},
        tooltip = "Click to spawn season elements",
    })
end

-- Spawn season elements on the indicator when clicked
function spawnSeasonElements()
    refreshIndicatorReference()
    if not seasonIndicator then return end
    
    local currentEmotion = getIndicatorEmotion()
    local elements = SEASON_TO_ELEMENTS[currentEmotion]
    if not elements then return end
    
    local indicatorPos = seasonIndicator.getPosition()
    
    -- Spawn first element slightly to the left of center
    local pos1 = Vector(indicatorPos.x - 0.5, indicatorPos.y + 1, indicatorPos.z)
    spawnObjectJSON({
        json = ELEMENT_JSON[elements[1]],
        position = pos1,
        rotation = {0, 180, 0}
    })
    
    -- Spawn second element slightly to the right of center
    local pos2 = Vector(indicatorPos.x + 0.5, indicatorPos.y + 1, indicatorPos.z)
    spawnObjectJSON({
        json = ELEMENT_JSON[elements[2]],
        position = pos2,
        rotation = {0, 180, 0}
    })
end

-- Dummy function for non-interactive buttons
function nullFunc()
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Toggle Time Passes Sync checkbox
-----------------------------------------

function toggleTimePasses(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    autoAdvanceOnTimePasses = not autoAdvanceOnTimePasses
    
    -- Update the button label to reflect new state
    local panel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
    if panel then
        createPanelButtons(panel)
    end
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Change Season (button click handler)
-----------------------------------------

function changeSeason(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    -- Prevent rapid clicks while season change is in progress
    if isChangingSeason then
        return
    end
    isChangingSeason = true

    -- Hide this script object after first activation
    if not activated then
        activated = true
        self.setInvisibleTo(Player.getColors())
    end

    local color = Global.call("getSpiritColor", {name = spiritName})
    local reverse = alt_click -- true for right-click (go backwards)

    -- INDICATOR-FIRST LOGIC: Cycle the indicator first, then sync the card to match
    -- This is robust to manual indicator edits or card/indicator desync
    local wantTag = cycleSeasonIndicator(reverse)

    -- Get the panel to search for cards across the entire panel area
    local panel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
    if not panel then
        isChangingSeason = false
        return
    end
    
    local panelPos = panel.getPosition()
    
    -- Cast a wide box covering the entire spirit panel
    -- Start at panel level and cast upward to catch cards sitting on the panel
    local hits = Physics.cast({
        origin = panelPos,
        direction = Vector(0, 1, 0),
        type = 3,
        size = {20, 1, 12},
        max_distance = 2,
        -- debug = true
    })

    -- Find current innate on panel (if any)
    local card = findInnateInHits(hits)
    
    -- Check if the card already matches the target emotion (no swap needed)
    if card then
        local currentEmotion = getCardEmotion(card)
        if currentEmotion == wantTag then
            -- Card already matches indicator, no swap needed
            isChangingSeason = false
            updateIndicatorDisplay()
            return
        end
    end
    
    local targetPos = pos + Vector(13, 0.5, -10)
    local targetRot = Vector(0, 180, 0)

    if card then
        targetPos = card.getPosition()
        targetRot = card.getRotation()
        -- Move current card to hand 3
        card.deal(1, color, 3)
    end

    -- Pull the card matching the indicator's new emotion from hand 3
    local replacement = findInnateWithTagInHand(color, 3, wantTag)
    if replacement then
        replacement.setPosition(targetPos, false)
        replacement.setRotation(targetRot, false)
    end

    -- Release lock after cards have time to settle (~0.5 seconds)
    Wait.frames(function()
        isChangingSeason = false
        -- Refresh display to show new season elements
        local refreshPanel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
        if refreshPanel then
            createPanelButtons(refreshPanel)
        end
    end, 30)
end

-----------------------------------------
-- Time Passes handler
-----------------------------------------

function timePasses()
    -- Check if auto-advance is disabled
    if not autoAdvanceOnTimePasses then
        return
    end
    
    -- Prevent rapid calls while season change is in progress
    if isChangingSeason then
        return
    end
    
    local color = Global.call("getSpiritColor", {name = spiritName})
    if not color then return end

    -- Get the panel to search for cards across the entire panel area
    local panel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
    if not panel then return end
    
    local panelPos = panel.getPosition()
    
    -- Cast a wide box covering the entire spirit panel
    -- Start at panel level and cast upward to catch cards sitting on the panel
    local hits = Physics.cast({
        origin = panelPos,
        direction = Vector(0, 1, 0),
        type = 3,
        size = {20, 1, 12},
        max_distance = 2,
        -- debug = true
    })

    -- Find current innate on panel (if any)
    local card = findInnateInHits(hits)
    
    -- Only proceed if there's a card on the panel
    if not card then
        return
    end
    
    isChangingSeason = true

    -- INDICATOR-FIRST LOGIC: Cycle the indicator forward, then sync the card to match
    local wantTag = cycleSeasonIndicator(false)  -- always forward for timePasses
    
    -- Check if the card already matches the target emotion (no swap needed)
    local currentEmotion = getCardEmotion(card)
    if currentEmotion == wantTag then
        isChangingSeason = false
        updateIndicatorDisplay()
        return
    end

    local targetPos = card.getPosition()
    local targetRot = card.getRotation()

    -- Move current card to hand 3
    card.deal(1, color, 3)

    -- Pull the card matching the indicator's new emotion from hand 3
    local replacement = findInnateWithTagInHand(color, 3, wantTag)
    if replacement then
        replacement.setPosition(targetPos, false)
        replacement.setRotation(targetRot, false)
    end

    -- Release lock after cards have time to settle (~0.5 seconds)
    Wait.frames(function()
        isChangingSeason = false
        -- Refresh display to show new season elements
        local refreshPanel = getObjectFromGUID(panelGUID)
        if refreshPanel then
            createPanelButtons(refreshPanel)
        end
    end, 30)
end
